{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Autumn evening, theatre, neat social band. Outer layer needed for autumn weather.

Day dress, knee-length A-line cut with long sleeves and a modest V-neckline, deep burgundy #6D1F34, fine wool crepe
Textured jacket, cropped tailored cut, hip-skimming length, charcoal grey #3E4147, wool bouclé
Sheer tights, sleek finish, deep black #1A1A1A, fine nylon
Ankle boots, block heel of moderate height, almond toe, black #1C1C1C, smooth leather
Handbag, small structured crossbody, black #1C1C1C, smooth leather
Earrings, small drop shape, antique gold #B08D57, brushed metal
Scarf, lightweight, draped loosely, soft grey #B8B6B3, merino and silk blend

This outfit suits a neat social evening at the theatre: the wool crepe day dress is polished without feeling overdressed, and the bouclé jacket adds texture and warmth for an autumn night. The deep burgundy reads rich under artificial theatre lighting, while the charcoal and black keep the palette grounded and cohesive. A block heel is comfortable for sitting through a performance and walking to and from the venue.
